video_title: Mikal Bridges on why the Knicks should win ‘Best Team’ at the 2026 ESPYS

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the fan reaction after winning the NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: I don't think I can really step outside my home, walk up a block without a lot of fans.
quotes.quote: It's been great. I don't think I can really step outside my home, walk up a block without a lot of fans, but it's cool because they deserve it. They've been here for so long, so I'm happy for them. Even for me stopping by and taking pictures of stuff, I know it means so much to them as well, so it's been pretty cool.

quotes.speaker: Host
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's impressive performance and championship run
quotes.excerpt: I hope he helps he sweeps everybody. I hope he wins them all.

text_blocks.speaker: Host
text_blocks.text: You do this on the biggest stage with your Villanova brothers, the stuff people dream about, right? Including Jalen Brunson, who's up for multiple awards, including Best Championship Performance, Best NBA Player. I mean, is he just going to win all of this? Does anybody stand a chance against this guy?

text_blocks.speaker: Mikal Bridges
text_blocks.text: I hope not. I hope he helps he sweeps everybody. I hope he wins them all.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on OG Anunoby's clutch tip-in during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I was the first person to celebrate with him when he was on the ground.
quotes.quote: I think I was the first person to celebrate with him when he was on the ground. So I think my reaction, I can just tell everybody I was the first to be right next to him when he made that tip-in. So it was crazy, just unbelievable about OG and just the determination and pretty much how he's been playing the whole playoffs. So it's just all his hard work and his effort, it was meant for that moment, so I'm happy for him.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the Knicks' championship celebration in San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: Obviously outside the parade, I was probably one of the best times.
quotes.quote: The celebration after and being on the court, being in the locker room, and being in the hallways in San Antonio is probably like, obviously outside the parade, I was probably one of the best times. Just seeing everybody, seeing our families, friends, just still processing that we just did this whole thing. It was real cool, that whole moment after we won and seeing everybody, and everybody's just drinking and letting loose and finally celebrating after a long year.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the Knicks' historic championship drought
quotes.excerpt: I just think just for the city, I think it's been a really long drought by 50 something years.
quotes.quote: I just think just for the city, I think it's been a really long drought by 50 something years. It's just, that's how I'll say, just how long the drought was and the city like New York, it's not easy, especially playing for this organization. So I'll say that's the reason why.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the team's flight back from San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: I think just the plane ride back from San Antonio.
quotes.quote: I think just the plane ride back from San Antonio. We didn't stay in San Antonio after, so we landed and got back to New York like 8:00 a.m. So I think just everybody being on that plane, bumping music, we're all sitting in the front like all our team and kind of reminiscing and talk about, you know, it was a long season, long grind. We were in Abu Dhabi in like September, October, so just all the moments, you know, the highs and lows to finally win a championship was, it was just dope to have everybody on the on the plane just talking about it.
